audit.whatIsWrong: Pyromania was described only as 'stacked stun' with no mechanism, and the interaction with Null Sphere was absent: Annie's stun (from Pyromania or Tibbers) cancels your Q mid-cast. audit.why: Riot: 'After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.' Riot: Disintegrate deals damage 'refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.' Null Sphere is flagged as an interruptible cast.
